newsitem.title: USA: Becton Dickinson sues Quidel in patent dispute.
newsitem.headline: Becton Dickinson sues Quidel in patent dispute.

text.p: Becton Dickinson and Co has sued Quidel Corp, alleging its products infringe two Becton patents for analytical laboratory tests.
In papers filed Monday in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Becton seeks a court order blocking further alleged infringement and unspecified damages tripled for willful infringement.

Becton says in the lawsuit that the products being challenged include Quidel's Conceive pregnancy test, the QuickVue One-Step hCG urine test, the Qtest pregnancy test, QuickVue In-Line One-Step Strep A test, an Ovulation Predictor test, and the QuickVue Chlamydia test.

Quidel Chief Financial Officer Steven Burke told Reuters "We don't believe we infringe. We have licenses for certain of their patents for particular products that we believe utilize their technology. We haven't licensed certain other products because in our opinion they don't use their technology. We have been in discussions with them about these differences but apparently they've lost patience."
